column1: # tools/oracle/css_cond_gen.py: the environments the condition differential asks in. Tab separated: name, viewport width, viewport height (CSS px), device pixel ratio.
# The browsers are put in each by WebDriver BiDi `browsingContext.setViewport` (both engines take a size and a ratio); every other feature of the environment (the pointer, the
# preferences, the color depth, the screen size) is not forced: the driver reads it from the page once, this library is given the same values, and the feature is
# compared at that one value (the divergence list calls a feature that cannot be put elsewhere `env-fixed`).
